message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Release vsix to OpenVSX and VSCode marketplace
on:
    release:
        types: [published]

jobs:
    release:
        name: "Release"
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v7
              with:
                  submodules: true

            - name: Set up Node.js
              uses: actions/setup-node@v7
              with:
                  node-version: 22.x

            - name: Cache npm dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@v4
              with:
                  path: node_modules
                  key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
                  restore-keys: |
                    ${{ runner.os }}-node-

            - name: Set up AdvanceCOMP
              run: |
                  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
                  apt-get update
                  apt-get -y install advancecomp

            - name: Install dependencies
              run: npm install

            - name: Run TypeScript compiler
              run: npx tsc

            - name: Build VSIX bundle
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12 # == v2.1.0
              id: build-vsix
              with:
                  dryRun: true
                  pat: 'stub'

            - name: Recompress VSIX bundle
              run: advzip -z4 ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Publish to Open VSX Registry
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12
              with:
                  pat: ${{ secrets.OPEN_VSX_TOKEN }}
                  extensionFile: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Publish to Visual Studio Marketplace
              uses: HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@1b8df468b849f76a143b8c18bf0ffa2075398d12
              with:
                  pat: ${{ secrets.VS_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN }}
                  registryUrl: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com
                  extensionFile: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}

            - name: Upload VSIX file to release page on GitHub
              uses: djn24/add-asset-to-release@dc65328ec8f76d54e5e71d930011a1da182a8406 # == v2
              with:
                  token: ${{secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN}}
                  path: ${{ steps.build-vsix.outputs.vsixPath }}",
  "rationale": "The release job runs `npm install` on every `release: published` trigger and the repository pins a `package-lock.json`, matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching with a lockfile cache input). Adding an `actions/cache@v4` step for `node_modules` keyed on the lockfile reuses dependency download state while leaving every build, typecheck, and publish step unchanged, so required coverage is preserved. No permissions are weakened, no secrets are added, and no new network access is introduced beyond the existing npm install.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
